content:
Yes, when you use `pyenv virtualenv-delete <venv-name>`, it will completely remove the virtual environment, including all installed packages within that environment. The entire directory containing the virtual environment will be deleted, so any packages you installed specifically in that virtual environment will be removed.

A few things to note:
- This action is irreversible
- It only affects the specified virtual environment
- It does not affect your global Python installation or other virtual environments

If you want to remove just the packages but keep the virtual environment, you would use `pip uninstall` instead.
